# Notorious DIT

> > Professional Digital Imaging Technician (DIT) services and dailies lab provider serving film and television productions across the UK.

Notorious DIT operates dailies labs in Glasgow, Liverpool, and London, offering comprehensive on-set workflow solutions, data management, and colour management services. Part of the Molinare Creative Group, they support major UK productions including drama, documentary, and reality television projects.
